title: Redevelopment of Singapore Turf Club Site and Completion Timelines
what_it_is: Redevelopment of Singapore Turf Club Site and Completion Timelines

sections.label: STC closure questions
sections.summary: Questions ask about housing and facilities on the STC site, alternatives to closure, and retraining for staff and trainers.

sentences.speaker: Ms Hany Soh
sentences.text: asked the Minister for National Development with respect to the announcement of the Singapore Turf Club (STC) closure in the press release dated 5 June 2023 (a) whether the Ministry is able to provide an estimated number of houses and the types of leisure and recreation facilities that will be developed on the STC site; and (b) what are the projected timelines for such developments and completions.

sentences.speaker: Ms Hany Soh
sentences.text: asked the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance in light of the announcement of the STC closure in the press release dated 5 June 2023, whether the Tote Board has considered alternatives to preserve the sport and leisure traditions of horse racing instead of an outright closure.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song
sentences.text: asked the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance with regard to the staff and trainers who currently work for horse owners but are not employed by STC, whether they will be supported by STC and other Government agencies in retraining for other jobs prior to the closure of STC.

sections.label: STC site redevelopment decision
sections.summary: The Government decided to redevelop the STC site due to demand for housing land and declining local horse racing spectatorship.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: With the demand for more land for housing and the declining spectatorship for local horse racing, the Government has made the difficult decision to redevelop the STC site to better meet our future needs.

sections.label: Revised land use plan work
sections.summary: Work on the revised land use plan and infrastructure design will take three to four years before the Government takes over in 2027.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: Work on the revised land use plan, as well as infrastructure design and planning for the site, will take place over the next three to four years before the Government takes over the site in 2027, so that land preparation and redevelopment can commence thereafter.

sections.label: STC land handover date
sections.summary: The handover of STC land and assets is scheduled to be completed by March 2027, three and a half years from now.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: The handover of the land and assets of STC is scheduled to be completed by March 2027, which is three and a half years from now.

sections.label: STC heritage commemoration
sections.summary: The National Heritage Board will work with STC and stakeholders to capture and commemorate STC and local horse racing heritage.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: The National Heritage Board will work with STC and stakeholders to capture and commemorate the heritage of STC and local horse racing.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: We will make every effort to assist those affected, and to ensure that the history and heritage of STC and the racing community is commemorated.

sections.label: Preserving STC memories in housing
sections.summary: A member asks to preserve memories and engage residents in housing, and an impact assessment with MOT is planned.

sentences.speaker: Ms Hany Soh (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: So, I am hoping that for the purposes of this redevelopment, when we establish our distinct identity, can we also look at how we can preserve many of these fond memories, engage the residents around the area to incorporate them into the housing, so that we can allow the future generations to still have some memories in relation to STC?

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: We will be working with MOT to do an impact assessment.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: In fact, that is one of the reasons why we need these three years before 2027 because you need to look at what are the infrastructure requirements around the place, the road network, the ease of traffic flow.

sections.label: Racehorse exportation to Australia
sections.summary: Australia is another destination taking in a smaller number, and exportation is the primary strategy so racehorses can continue racing if owners choose.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: Australia is another destination although, for Australia, they take in a smaller number.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: So, I think the primary strategy for these racehorses would actually be exportation, to allow them to continue to race if their owners so choose.

sections.label: Last race and land timeline
sections.summary: The last race is expected in fifteen months, the Gold Cup in October 2024, and taking back the land in 2027 requires time for horse exportation.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: Fifteen months is the period when we expect the last race to take place.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: So, the last race to take place would be the Gold Cup next year, in October 2024.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: Working backwards, if we take back the land in 2027, you need to allow time for horse exportation as well.

sections.label: Kranji and Bukit Timah Turf Club sites
sections.summary: About 20-odd years after the Turf Club relocated from Bukit Timah to Kranji, no residential development has occurred there despite land earmarked since Master Plan 1998.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
sentences.text: The reason why I am asking is because it has been about 20-odd years since the Turf Club relocated from Bukit Timah to Kranji, and I think, over there, there has not been any residential development as yet, even though the land has been earmarked for residential use since Master Plan 1998.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: Mr Chua's question actually covers two different sites – one is the Kranji Turf Club and the other is the Bukit Timah Turf Club, now known as Turf City.

sections.label: Winding down between 2024 and 2027
sections.summary: The best approach is to use the time between the 2024 last race and 2027 to rehome and export horses, find employees jobs, and wind down orderly.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: It is not going to increase the number of people coming, which was already on a downward trajectory.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: So, the best approach is to use the time between 2024, with the last race, and 2027, to rehome the horses, export them, find jobs for the employees and do an orderly winding down and not hold back the housing programme.

sections.label: Development completion and infrastructure
sections.summary: One is scheduled for completion around 2031/2032, and it will be developed with housing, but surrounding infrastructure and road network must be built first.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: I think that one is scheduled for completion in 2031/2032, around there.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: So, the short answer is, it will be developed, there will be housing, but we need to build up the surrounding infrastructure and road network first.

sections.label: STC engagements after announcement
sections.summary: Immediately after the announcement, STC embarked on engagements with the trainers and the horse owners.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: Immediately after the announcement, STC embarked on engagements with the trainers and the horse owners.

sections.label: Public consultation on land acquisition
sections.summary: The speaker says market-sensitive matters like land acquisition are not subject to public consultation, but decisions may draw on earlier feedback, and consultation will be done as much as possible.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: When we do placemaking, the long-term plan review was one such.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: So, I think that there is a category where it is sensitive, meaning, market-sensitive, and you would not normally go out and say, "Can I have public consultation on whether I want to do land acquisition?" That is a category that you would not do public consultation on.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: But your decision in deciding whether or not to do the land acquisition may be a result of previous consultations on feedback, congestion, what people want and so on.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: So, the short answer is we will do as much public consultation as we can.
